kitLoot.note: Shape-compatible with @lunego/kit-loot. Build one LootTable per (slot, kind, ilvl): pick rarity from dropTables.rarityWeights, then pick family by weight, then tier by tier.weight, then call rollLoot on a single-affix table built from this tier.rolls.
